verdict.rationale: mise ships an MCP server (mise-docs-74) that lets an AI assistant inspect a project's tools/tasks/config and run mise tasks, effectively enabling natural-language operation via an AI agent, but there is no native natural-language CLI or independent hands-on evidence of this working in practice. missing for 10: first-party or independent evidence of actual natural-language command execution/testing, richer documentation beyond a single mcp.html mention, and confirmation this works well in real AI-assistant workflows.
